title: Duration report: a failing Node TODO test is counted and can be listed as slow
outcome: In scripts/test-durations.mjs the Node event parser classifies test:fail before checking todo. A TODO test whose body fails therefore becomes state "failed", passes the filter that excludes skipped and todo tests, and is counted in the totals and the slow-test list. docs/test.md says TODO tests are not counted. The fix checks the skip and todo flags independently of pass or fail, and adds a regression case for a failing TODO event.
acceptance: A failing TODO test event is excluded from the duration report's test count and over-budget list; a test covers it.
